title: Decoding-Time Debiasing via Process Reward Models: From Controlled Fill-in to Open-Ended Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating single-word fill-ins and open-ended continuations from stereotype-eliciting prompts (e.g., regarding professional roles, leadership, and caregiving) using an LLM-based Process Reward Model (PRM) judge to score fairness.
